title: Sharp finite-coordinate hypercontractivity
statement: Let $I$ be a finite set with weights $w_i\in\bbr$ satisfying $\sum_{i\in I}w_i=1$. Let $\lambda,q,\rho\in\bbr$ satisfy $0<\lambda<1/2$, $w_i\ge\lambda$ for every $i\in I$, $q>2$, $0\le\rho$, and $\rho\le\rho_*(q,\lambda)$, where $\rho_*(q,\lambda)=\sqrt{\sinh(u/q)/\sinh(u/(q/(q-1)))}$ and $u=\log((1-\lambda)/\lambda)$. For every $g:I\to\bbr$, both weighted norm inequalities hold: $\bigl(\sum_{i\in I}w_i|\rho g_i+(1-\rho)\sum_{j\in I}w_jg_j|^q\bigr)^{1/q}\le\bigl(\sum_{i\in I}w_i|g_i|^2\bigr)^{1/2}$ and $\bigl(\sum_{i\in I}w_i|\rho g_i+(1-\rho)\sum_{j\in I}w_jg_j|^2\bigr)^{1/2}\le\bigl(\sum_{i\in I}w_i|g_i|^{q/(q-1)}\bigr)^{(q-1)/q}$.
replaced: Let $I$ be finite with weights $w_i\ge\lambda$, $\sum_iw_i=1$, $0<\lambda<1/2$, and $q>2$. Put $r=\sqrt{\sinh(\log((1-\lambda)/\lambda)/q)/\sinh(\log((1-\lambda)/\lambda)/(q/(q-1)))}$. For $0\le\rho\le r$, the operator $Ng=\rho g+(1-\rho)\sum_iw_ig_i$ satisfies $\|Ng\|_{q,w}\le\|g\|_{2,w}$ and $\|Ng\|_{2,w}\le\|g\|_{q/(q-1),w}$. Here $\|h\|_{p,w}=(\sum_{i\in I}w_i|h_i|^p)^{1/p}$ for $p>0$.
